desc: Analyze structure: BFS layer decomposition from vertex 1; edges only within a layer or between adjacent layers; each layer>0 vertex needs a neighbor in the previous layer; parity condition is total odd-indexed layer size = N/2.
Implement DP over (used u, odd count o, last layer size p, last-layer parity), each state an edge-count polynomial; transition with next layer size s using C(N-u,s) * ((1+x)^p-1)^s * (1+x)^{C(s,2)}.
Enforce terminal conditions (u=N, o=N/2); extract coefficients for M=N-1..C(N,2) via evaluation at t=0..L-1 and Lagrange interpolation, print space-separated mod P.
Validate against samples N=4,6,10 -- all three public samples PASSED.
Benchmark at N=30, P=998244353 confirmed: ~0.5s wall-clock, ~50MB, exactly 407 outputs in [0,P), no overflow; all 3 samples PASS and N=2 prints `1`.
No performance/memory reduction needed since N=30 benchmark is well within limits; algorithm unchanged.
